ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Welfare-Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged welfare-fraud scandal in Minnesota and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the scandal.
questions: What is the extent of the welfare-fraud scandal in Minnesota?
Who is behind the scandal and how did they carry it out?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal and hold those responsible accountable. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of financial records and interviews with key figures.
